description: Costs 5¢ per call. Reads a datasheet image with vision AI: a graph, package drawing, pin diagram or schematic that read_datasheet returned. Pass the image_key from that response (the storage path in the image URL), optionally with a question. For exact electrical values prefer read_datasheet's text tables; use this for what only the picture shows (package dimensions, pin assignments, curve trends, approximate values off a curve). Example: analyze_image(part_number='IRFZ44N', image_key='images/abc123.png', question='What is the drain current at Vgs=5V?')

image_key.description: Image storage path from read_datasheet output (e.g. 'images/abc123.png')

question.description: Optional question about the image (e.g. 'What are the package dimensions?')

name: analyze_image
title: Analyze Datasheet Image
